'''Tunnel tubes''' are a type of [[underground]] [[tree]]. They are found in deep [[caverns]], and will grow on any [[mud|muddied]] [[rock]] or [[soil]] once found. When cut down, they yield violet logs suitable for producing colorful furniture. (Note that [[rose gold]] is the same color, and can also be used to create furniture other than [[bed]]s, so if you are able to create it, breaching the second cavern layer may not be necessary.)

Some [[Dwarf|dwarves]] [[Preferences|like]] tunnel tubes for their ''curving trunk''.
